verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone and texting platform, so automatic STOP/HELP keyword handling and opt-out suppression is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions keyword handling, opt-out management, or suppression of opted-out contacts. The texting and broadcast items describe sending capability only, not compliance handling.

support.subject: As a support leader, STOP and HELP keywords are handled automatically and opted-out contacts are suppressed from future sends
